description: Returns the account behind the sign-in (OAuth or API key): credit balance, whether a credit reconciliation blocks new charges, and the key's prefix and scopes. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key). Use it to check the balance before starting an analysis or after a payment_required error. It does not change the balance: credits are managed in the user's SurveysAI account on the website.
name: qualitative_get_account
title: Get account and credit balance
